# Generated by mods/where_to_produce/tools/generate.py. Do not edit by hand.
#
# The plan editor. Everything here changes a plan that already exists and
# **nothing here re-runs the plan**: `bag_wtp_plan_run` is the only thing that
# does, and pressing it throws every edit away, which is why the save slot exists.

# The building this location would give up most cheaply, and which good it is.
#
# `-1` in `_esw` means "nothing here may be taken out at all" -- every building
# is either its good's last on the ground or part of the town's charter bundle.
# **A gain of nought is a real answer and `-1` is not**, which is why the empty
# marker cannot be nought: a good the ground feeds nothing is exactly the one an
# edit should be taking out first.
# Scope: location

	# may go wins outright and the rest is a comparison between goods.

			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay }
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn1 > 1
				NOT = { bag_wtp_edit_locked_1 = yes }
				# **Two different locks meet on this line and they are not the same
				# thing.** `_edit_locked_<n>` above is the charter's: this building
				# belongs to a town right's bundle and the bundle goes whole or not at
				# all. `_lock<n>` here is the player's: he pressed this good and it
				# stays where he put it.
				#
				# **A good the player pinned is never the one that gives way.** The
				# second of the lock's three consequences: pressing «+1» on iron must
				# not quietly undo the «−1» he spent on cloth a moment ago. Note this
				# is `_lock<n>` and not `_skip<n>`: «не нужен» says «never fill this
				# past its minimum», which makes its buildings *better* candidates to
				# give up, not protected ones.
				NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_lock1 }
				# **The good that gave way is the one furthest above its share, and
				# its cheapest building is the one that goes.** Step 3, and it is
				# the eviction side of the rule the fill already obeys: «−1» hands
				# a freed room to the good furthest *below* its share.
				#
				# **Two keys and one pass, exactly as the fill does it** -- `_esx`
				# carries the best excess so far and `_esw` the gain that goes with
				# it, so «more bloated» and «as bloated but cheaper to lose» are two
				# arms of one `OR`. Not a packed `превышение × K + выгода`: the
				# engine's fixed-point limit is not known from here, and the same
				# warning already stands over `_plan_order`.
				#
				# On the strict pass a good at or below its share is not a victim
				# at all. `bag_wtp_edit_add` runs the scan strict first and repeats
				# it open only if nothing qualified, so this narrows and never blocks.
				OR = {
					global_var:bag_wtp_edit_strict = 0

						}
					}
				}

bag_wtp_edit_scan_1 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_1 = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban }
				# A free room costs nothing, so it always outbids an eviction.
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv add = 1000 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_esw >= 0 var:bag_wtp_esg > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv subtract = var:bag_wtp_esw }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_1 = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_rural }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = var:bag_wtp_pr1 }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv add = 1000 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_esw >= 0 var:bag_wtp_esg > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = var:bag_wtp_pr1 }

				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = var:bag_wtp_pr47 }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv add = 1000 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_esw >= 0 var:bag_wtp_esg > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = var:bag_wtp_pr47 }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv subtract = var:bag_wtp_esw }
			}
		}
	}
}

# clay out of this location, town side.
#
# **Every counter the plan keeps is walked back**, because the report and the
# next edit both read them: the load, the total placed, this good's own count,
# and the two gain counters the header prints.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay }
			# **The side is asked here too, and it was not.** `call()` emits both
			# variants and the town one came first, so a village location had its
			# *town* gain subtracted from `_plan_gain` and its building matched
			# against `_pm<n>` instead of `_prm<n>`. Placement has always asked --
			# `_edit_fits_*` carries `bag_wtp_plan_is_town` -- and the two halves
			# of one edit have to agree about what kind of place this is.
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
		}
		remove_list_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm1 = 83
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm1 = 83 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout1 subtract = 100 } }
			remove_list_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:clay_pit }
		}
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load subtract = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed subtract = 1 }
		# **И счётчик комнат своей стороны.** Постановка его растит, снятие обязано
		# уменьшать: без этого обмен считался как две постановки, и «по сторонам»
		# вышло 578 из 528 (прогон 2026-09-09).
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pt subtract = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn1 subtract = 1 }
		# **И счёт своей стороны по этому товару.** Постановка растит
		# `_pnt<n>`, снятие его не возвращало: `_pnt<n>` и `_pnr<n>`
		# росли от каждого круга «убрал -- поставил», а на них стоят ряды
		# и сводка.
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt1 subtract = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain subtract = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_p1 > 0 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed subtract = 1 }
		}
	}
}

		# **И счёт своей стороны по этому товару.** Постановка растит
		# `_pnr<n>`, снятие его не возвращало: `_pnt<n>` и `_pnr<n>`
		# росли от каждого круга «убрал -- поставил», а на них стоят ряды
		# и сводка.
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnr1 subtract = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain subtract = var:bag_wtp_pr1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_pr1 > 0 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed subtract = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Every pin released, and nothing else touched.
#
# **The pin needed a way out.** It is written by every «+1» and «−1», so a few
# minutes of editing pins most of the ground -- his 192 presses left 16 goods
# pinned holding 126 of 192 rooms -- and until this button the only way back was
# «Пересчитать» on the mod's page, which throws the edited plan away as well.
# This releases the pins and leaves the plan exactly where it stands: the shares
# are recomputed over all the goods again, and the next «−1» fills by them.
#
# The «не нужен» flags are not touched. They are a different statement and have
# their own control.

# **Where the editor ends.** `_lock<n>`, `_skip<n>`, the share below, the star in
# a cell -- **all of it belongs to the editor window and to nothing else.**
# Pressing «План» on the mod's page gives a fresh plan, full stop: it does not
# read a pin, a flag, or anything the editor did. That was crossed on
# 2026-09-05, when `_pq<n>` was held at 1 for a flagged good and the open ladder
# was taught to skip it -- so a click in the editor quietly steered the next
# global plan. His words, 2026-09-06: «слава богу я получаю просто новый план, а
# не план в котором какой-то домик закреплён на лимите 1».
#
# The flag's real scope is «never top this good up **while editing**», on this
# ground and the next. It survives a replan because it is the player's standing
# preference for the editor -- not because the plan owes it anything.

# The share a good still free is entitled to, and how far each one is below it.
#
# Recomputed at the top of every press, because a press can pin a good and the
# next press must see it. Cheap: two passes over the goods and no walk of the
# ground at all.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_set_quota = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_pool_rooms value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_rooms }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_free value = 0 }

#
# Called from inside both ordered walks, standing on the location: `_esg` is a
# location variable and there is nowhere else to read it. It is only meaningful
# where the walk set it -- `> 0` -- and the global is removed rather than zeroed
# before every press, so «ничего не вытеснено» leaves nothing behind to print.

# The walk's trace, cleared before every press.
#
# **Zero and «no walk happened» must not look alike.** `_ev_hit` is 0 when the
# ordered walk found no candidate at all, and 1 when it stood somewhere -- and
# then the rest of these say what it saw there. The diagnostics print them; that
# is the whole reason they exist. The owner, 2026-09-04: «Добавляй скан
# информации для себя в диагностике на функцию редактора, чтобы ты видел чё там
# происходит.»
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_clear_trace = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_hit value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_town value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_load value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_load2 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_esg value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_esw value = 0 }
	# **The three the press line is written from, and they are scopes, not
	# numbers.** A scope variable has no zero to be set to, so it is removed
	# instead -- and it must be, because the line names what it finds: a stale
	# location left over from the previous press would be read as this one's.
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_ev_loc
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_ev_esg_s
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_evicted value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_room value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_mark value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_rshort value = 0 }
}


# **The press journal, one line a press, straight into `debug.log`.**
#
# The changes window is a diff against the saved plan and not a log: two presses
# on the same location merge into one row and the order of them is gone. The
# owner, 2026-09-05: «В окне изменений -- всё смешивается. Там нет хронологии
# изменений… Так что сам проверяй всё в диагностике.» A diff cannot hold
# chronology, and the log already is chronology -- it is written in press order
# by construction and nothing has to remember anything.
#
# **The location is named by `debug_log_scopes`, from inside its own scope.** A
# `debug_log` string cannot reach a scope, and `_ev_loc` is a global holding one,
# so the effect steps into it and lets the engine write the name on the line
# above. That is the same trick every `L` block of the report uses.
#
# Numbers go through the report's own scratch globals, because
# `[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue(...)]` is the one form that
# reads from a `debug_log` anywhere -- measured 2026-09-02. Goods are numbers
# here and names in the report's `G<n>` lines: `tools/diag.py` puts the two
# together, and baking 47 branches into every press to save it the trouble would
# cost a dispatch on the hot path for nothing.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_journal = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv1 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_presses } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv1 value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_presses } }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv2 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_op } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv2 value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_op } }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv3 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_good } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv3 value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_good } }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv4 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ev_hit } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv4 value = global_var:bag_wtp_ev_hit } }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv5 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_done } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv5 value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_done } }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv6 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_fail } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv6 value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_fail } }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv7 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_norefill } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv7 value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_norefill } }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv8 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ev_esg } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv8 value = global_var:bag_wtp_ev_esg } }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv9 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_evicted } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv9 value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_evicted } }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv10 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_rfrom } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv10 value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom } }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv11 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_rto } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv11 value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto } }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv12 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_right } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv12 value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_right } }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv13 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_rshort } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv13 value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rshort } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ev_loc }
		global_var:bag_wtp_ev_loc = {
			debug_log_scopes = no
			# **Метка, потому что «строка выше» -- не адрес.** В первом прогоне
			# 2026-09-06 между именем локации и строкой нажатия влезла
			# `Important assertion failed: … (Getting player in synchronous
			# state)` -- движок ругается на `GetPlayer` внутри `debug_log`, один
			# раз за сессию, -- и читалка подписала нажатие ею. Метка не читает
			# ничего: между ней и именем встать нечему.
			debug_log = "WTP PRESSAT"
		}
	}
	debug_log = "WTP PRESS n=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg1')|0] op=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg2')|0] good=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg3')|0] right=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg12')|0] hit=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg4')|0] | done=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg5')|0] fail=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg6')|0] norefill=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg7')|0] | esg=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg8')|0] evicted=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg9')|0] | rfrom=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg10')|0] rto=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg11')|0] short=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg13')|0]"
}

# **One more building of the chosen good, and exactly one.**
#
# The ordered walk is the whole of the choice: `_esv` is what each candidate
# charges -- a free room charges nothing and outbids everything, an eviction
# charges the victim's gain -- so the highest is the least painful place, and
# `max = 1` takes it and stops. Both sides' effects are called and the one whose
# side the location is not simply does nothing, which is cheaper than asking.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_add = {
	# **The press counter, and it is a probe rather than a nicety.** A press that
	# never reaches its effect and a press that reaches it and is refused look the
	# same on screen -- «ничего не изменилось» -- and telling them apart has cost
	# two runs. The window prints this number, so one look answers it: click five
	# times, the number does not move, the button is not wired.
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_presses add = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_clear_trace = yes
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_done value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_fail value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_norefill value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_op value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_set_quota = yes
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_fitn value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_cands value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_good > 0 }
		# **Two passes, and the second only when the first found nobody.**
		# Strict: the building given up must belong to a good that is over
		# its share. Open: any building that may be taken out at all. A
		# location with a free room qualifies on both — it has no victim to
		# ask about, and a free room outbids every eviction anyway.
		#
		# **Not one packed `order_by` number.** `превышение × K + выгода`
		# was the other way and it is rejected: the engine's fixed-point
		# limit is not known from here, and the same warning already
		# stands over `_plan_order`.
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_strict value = 1 }
		bag_wtp_edit_scan_pass = yes
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_cands = 0 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_strict value = 0 }
			bag_wtp_edit_scan_pass = yes
		}
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_esc = 1 }
			order_by = bag_wtp_edit_order
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			# **One rule, and the walk owns the room.**
			#
			# The editor no longer asks the plan whether a building may stand here.
			# `_plan_can_*` wants a free room; the editor makes the room itself, so it
			# asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the same test with that clause removed -- and
			# **the scan and the placement are then the same predicate**. They used to
			# be two, and the day they disagreed the window said «поставить не
			# удалось, и всё осталось как было» with nothing able to say why.
			#
			# So: evict when the location is full and has a victim, then place if the
			# room is actually free. `_edit_worst` names a victim on every candidate
			# -- the picker's markers need that -- so «full» and «has a victim» are
			# asked here rather than assumed.
			# **What the walk stood on, parked for the report.** A `debug_log` string
			# cannot reach the item a walk is standing on, so the numbers that decide
			# everything here -- the location's load, its victim, whether it counts as
			# a town -- have to be copied into globals as they are read. Without this
			# the editor is the one part of the mod the diagnostics cannot see, and
			# 2026-09-04 is what that costs: 27 buildings over the cap and four
			# theories about why.
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_hit value = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_town value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_town value = 1 } }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_load value = var:bag_wtp_load }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_esg value = var:bag_wtp_esg }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_esw value = var:bag_wtp_esw }
			# **And the same two in words, for the window.** The report reads the
			# numbers above; the press line cannot, so the location the walk chose and
			# the good it would evict are parked as scopes here as well. This is the
			# only point in the press where both are in hand.
			bag_wtp_edit_name_esg = yes
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_ev_where
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_loc value = scope:bag_wtp_ev_where }
			# **And which press this was, on the location itself.** The changes
			# window is a diff and cannot hold chronology, but it can be *ordered*
			# by it: `_chg_seq` is what `bag_wtp_chg_order` sorts the list on, so
			# ten «+1» on one good come out as ten rows in a row instead of
			# scattered through the land by location id. The owner, 2026-09-06:
			# «я ожидаю увидеть несколько строк подряд, где участвует кожа».
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_seq value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_presses }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_evicted value = 0 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_room value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:bag_wtp_esg > 0
					OR = {
						AND = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
							var:bag_wtp_load >= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban }
						AND = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
							var:bag_wtp_load >= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_rural }
					}
				}
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_esg = 1 }
				bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_1 = yes
				bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_1 = yes
			}
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_esg = 2 }
				bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_2 = yes
				bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_2 = yes
			}
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_esg = 3 }

# **One building of the chosen good taken out, and the room given to whatever
# suits it best afterwards.** «Он уступает место тому у чего забрал слоты.»
#
# The walk takes the good's *worst* placement, which is why the scan stores
# `1000 - gain`: `order_by` reads highest-first and there is no other way
# to ask it for a minimum.
# Scope: country

	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_presses add = 1 }

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_nofill value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_good }
	bag_wtp_edit_set_quota = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_count_held = yes
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_cands value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_good > 0 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = 0 }

				bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_48 = yes
			}
			if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 49 }
				bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_49 = yes
			}
			if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 50 }
				bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_50 = yes
			}
			# The room is free now; the good furthest below its share takes it.
			bag_wtp_edit_fill_room = yes
			# **What the fill just put here, remembered for the reshuffle.** Which
			# good takes the room is settled by shortfall, and that is right; *where*
			# it lands is settled by which press freed which room, and that is
			# nobody's decision at all. `bag_wtp_edit_reshuffle` trades these
			# buildings between their own locations afterwards.
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_esg > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_fillg value = var:bag_wtp_esg }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_edit_fillset target = this } } }
					add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_edit_fillset target = this }
				}
			}
			# **Who took it, for the report and for the press line.** On «−1» `_esg` is
			# the good that moved in rather than a victim, and both readings are the
			# walk's answer to «what changed here», so they share the globals.
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_esg value = var:bag_wtp_esg }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_esw value = var:bag_wtp_esw }
			bag_wtp_edit_name_esg = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_load2 value = var:bag_wtp_load }
			# **Whether anything took the room.** «−1» has done its job either way --
			# the building is out, which is what was asked -- but «освободилось и
			# занять нечем» and «освободилось, встал такой-то» are different answers
			# and the window has to give the right one.
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_esg = 0 }
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_norefill value = 1 }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_done value = 1 }
		}
	}
	bag_wtp_edit_reshuffle = yes
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_done = 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_idle add = 1 }
	}
	bag_wtp_edit_journal = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_rank = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_show = yes
}

# **One free room, given to the good furthest below its share.**
#
# Called by «−1», which frees a room by taking a building out, and by the
# charter machine, which frees rooms by taking a whole bundle out. **The
# exclusion is `_edit_nofill` and not `_edit_good`**: «−1» must not hand the room
# straight back to the good it just took out -- it fits by construction and is
# almost always the best fit, so the press would report «сделано» with nothing
# changed on the map -- but a charter press has no such good and excluding
# whatever the goods picker happens to point at would be an accident.
#
# **The freed room goes to the good furthest below its share, not to the
# richest.** His words, 2026-09-04: «остальные, у которых не хватало до 7
# равномерных, начнут по 1 заполнять места, чтобы добрать свою
# равнозначность по количеству. А если у всех уже и так равность… туда будут
# вставать по своей выгоде от земли.» Gain decides only a tie -- and «no
# shortfall at all» is a tie at zero, which is that second sentence.
#
# **This is also why the lock had to be built in the same step.** Under
# hunger alone, a good the player has just pressed down to one building is
# the hungriest thing on the ground and climbs straight back into the next
# good's rooms -- he found that himself, walking court materials from 7 to 1
# and then herbs from 8 to 1. `_lock<n>` is what keeps a pressed good out of
# this scan entirely, and on 2026-09-05 he confirmed the behaviour this must
# preserve: goods he drops by hand stay dropped.
#
# Two keys and one pass, not a packed number: `_esd` carries the best
# shortfall so far and `_esw` the gain that goes with it, so «strictly
# hungrier» and «equally hungry but worth more» are two arms of one `OR`.
# Scope: location

	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esw value = -1 }

# Everything the reshuffle remembers, forgotten. A fresh plan or a loaded slot
# is a different set of buildings, and a marker left on a location would trade
# something the fill never put there.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_clear_fillset = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_edit_fillset
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_fillg
	}
	# **И номера нажатий тоже.** Они упорядочивают «Показать изменения», а
	# счётчик нажатий обнуляется вместе с окном: оставленный номер разложил
	# бы новую правку по порядку старой.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_chg_seq
	}
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_edit_fillset
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_edit_fillset2
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_swaps value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_rounds value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_pairs value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_same value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_nofit value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_worse value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_gain value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_did value = 0 }
}

# Three rounds at most, and it stops the moment one of them trades nothing.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_reshuffle = {
	# **What the trading is worth, kept as one number.** The gain is the
	# whole reason this pass exists and nothing on screen showed it, so a
	# run could not tell «traded nothing» from «traded and it was worth
	# nothing» from «never ran». The changes window prints it.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_gain0 value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_gain }
	bag_wtp_edit_reshuffle_round = yes
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rs_did = 1 }
		bag_wtp_edit_reshuffle_round = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rs_did = 1 }
		bag_wtp_edit_reshuffle_round = yes
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_gain add = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_gain }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_gain subtract = global_var:bag_wtp_rs_gain0 }
}

					scope:bag_wtp_rs_a = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_seq value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_presses } }
					set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_stop value = 1 }
					set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_did value = 1 }
					change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_swaps add = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

# fishing_village с локации долой -- обратное к `bag_wtp_plan_try_village_1`, строка
# в строку. Без него деревня, однажды поставленная, стоит вечно: снять её было
# нечем, и обмен обойти её не мог.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_plan_drop_village_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:fishing_village } }
		remove_list_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:fishing_village }
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_vw1 = 6 }
			remove_list_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fish }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_vw1 = 39 }
			remove_list_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:naval_supplies }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_vw1 = 42 }
			remove_list_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:pottery }
		}
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load subtract = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed subtract = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pr subtract = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_bn1 subtract = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain subtract = var:bag_wtp_vb1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_vb1 > 0 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed subtract = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Какая деревня стоит на этой локации, номером.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_mv_find_village = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_vk value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:fishing_village } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_vk value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:forest_village } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_vk value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:market_village } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_vk value = 3 }
	}
}

# Встанет ли сюда деревня `_mv_vk`, если освободить одну комнату.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_mv_village_fits = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_vfit value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_vk > 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_vk = 1
				var:bag_wtp_vw1 > 0
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:fishing_village } }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						var:bag_wtp_vw1 = 6
						NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fish } }
					}
					AND = {
						var:bag_wtp_vw1 = 39
						NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:naval_supplies } }
					}
					AND = {
						var:bag_wtp_vw1 = 42
						NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:pottery } }
					}
				}
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_vfit value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_vk = 2
				var:bag_wtp_vw2 > 0
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:forest_village } }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						var:bag_wtp_vw2 = 23
						NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:wild_game } }
					}
					AND = {
						var:bag_wtp_vw2 = 36
						NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:leather } }
					}
					AND = {
						var:bag_wtp_vw2 = 46
						NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:tools } }
					}
					AND = {
						var:bag_wtp_vw2 = 47
						NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:weaponry } }
					}
				}
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_vfit value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_vk = 3
				var:bag_wtp_vw3 > 0
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:market_village } }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						var:bag_wtp_vw3 = 26
						NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:beer } }
					}
					AND = {
						var:bag_wtp_vw3 = 34
						NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:jewelry } }
					}
					AND = {
						var:bag_wtp_vw3 = 42
						NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:pottery } }
					}
					AND = {
						var:bag_wtp_vw3 = 46
						NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:tools } }
					}
					AND = {

# Scope: location
bag_wtp_mv_drop_village = {
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_vk = 1 } bag_wtp_plan_drop_village_1 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_vk = 2 } bag_wtp_plan_drop_village_2 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_vk = 3 } bag_wtp_plan_drop_village_3 = yes }
}

# Scope: location
bag_wtp_mv_put_village = {
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_vk = 1 } bag_wtp_plan_try_village_1 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_vk = 2 } bag_wtp_plan_try_village_2 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_vk = 3 } bag_wtp_plan_try_village_3 = yes }

# «Перетасовать»: обмен местами **между провинциями**.
#
# **Внутри провинции обменивать нечего, и это факт из файлов игры.** Выгода
# считается `province_definition = { any_location_in_province_definition = {
# raw_material = goods:X } }`: одно РГО где угодно в провинции кормит каждую её
# локацию одинаково. Первая версия торговала внутри провинции и не могла дать
# ничего; владелец поймал это с одного взгляда, 2026-09-09: «у них везде будет
# один и тот же бонус от земли».
#
# **Пар не перебираем.** Обмен всех со всеми -- это 416² за круг. Вместо этого
# на каждый товар и сторону один обход земли: где ему платят больше всего и где
# стоит его худший домик. Партнёром берётся тот, кем помечена цель --
# `_plan_pick_worst` метит локацию худшим стоящим там своим домиком. Это
# `товары × локации`, а не `локации²`.
#
# **Домиков не меняет ни у кого**: у обоих товаров как было, так и осталось.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_shuffle = {
	# **Свои счётчики, а не `_rs_*`.** Те стирает открытие окна редактора
	# (`_edit_clear_fillset`), и прогон 2026-09-09 напечатал `rounds=0 swaps=0`
	# после перетасовки, которая переставила 36 локаций.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_swaps value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_rounds value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_gain0 value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_gain }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_rswaps value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_rrounds value = 0 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_presses add = 1 }
	# **Сначала грамоты, потом всё остальное** -- его порядок, 2026-09-09.
	# Грамота везёт с собой пачку домиков, так что её переезд меняет землю под
	# ногами у товарного обмена: считать товарам есть смысл только по уже
	# переставленным грамотам.
	#
	# `_edit_right_prepare` -- то же, с чего начинается любое нажатие на
	# грамоте: доли, разрешения и `_edit_strict = 0`, без которого выравнивание
	# загрузки города отказалось бы отдавать домик и город остался бы выше
	# своего потолка.
	bag_wtp_edit_right_prepare = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_shuffle_rights = yes
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ps_did = 1 }
		bag_wtp_plan_shuffle_rights = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ps_did = 1 }
		bag_wtp_plan_shuffle_rights = yes
	}
	bag_wtp_plan_shuffle_round = yes
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ps_did = 1 }
		bag_wtp_plan_shuffle_round = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ps_did = 1 }
		bag_wtp_plan_shuffle_round = yes
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_fillg
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_gain value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_gain }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_gain subtract = global_var:bag_wtp_ps_gain0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_ran value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_plan_rank = yes
}

# clay, town: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_t1 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 1 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
		}
		# Куда: лучшее место, где его домик мог бы стоять и ещё не стоит.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_1 = yes
				# **И только под своё здание.** `_edit_fits_rural_<n>` пускает и
				# деревенский рецепт: украшения «влезли бы» в торговую деревню, а
				# постановка добавила бы саму деревню -- ровно тот двойной счёт,
				# который убирали всю сессию.
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_pm1 = 83 }
				var:bag_wtp_p1 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		# Откуда: худшее место, где стоит его **своё** здание.
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:clay_pit } }
				var:bag_wtp_p1 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
			global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
		}
		# Кто стоит в цели и что он там получает.
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_traded value = 0 }
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_to = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_fillg }
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = var:bag_wtp_fillg }
			}
			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bto value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bgain }
		}
		# Что он получит там, куда поедет, и влезет ли он туда вообще.
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_from = {
			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bfrom value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bgain }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bfitf value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bfit }
		}
		# Паре вместе должно стать лучше, а не одному из двоих.
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_new value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_new add = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bfrom }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_now value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_now add = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bto }
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg > 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bfitf = 1
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_new > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_now
			}
			# **Сначала в цель, потом из источника.** Товар на миг стоит дважды и
			# возвращается к своему числу; постановка квоты не спрашивает, только
			# «влезет ли» и «есть ли комната», а комнату освобождает строка выше.
			scope:bag_wtp_mv_to = {
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 1 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_1 = yes
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_1 = yes
				}
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 2 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_2 = yes
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_2 = yes
				}
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 3 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_3 = yes
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_3 = yes
				}
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 4 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_4 = yes
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_4 = yes
				}
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 5 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_5 = yes
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_5 = yes
				}
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 6 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_6 = yes
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_6 = yes
				}
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 7 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_7 = yes
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_7 = yes
				}
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 8 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_8 = yes
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_8 = yes
				}
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 9 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_9 = yes
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_9 = yes
				}
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 10 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_10 = yes
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_10 = yes
				}
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 11 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_11 = yes
				}
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 12 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_12 = yes
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_12 = yes
				}
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 13 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_13 = yes
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_13 = yes
				}
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 14 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_14 = yes
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_14 = yes
				}
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 15 }

				}
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 16 }

# clay, rural: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_r1 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 1 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_1 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm1 = 83 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr1 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr1 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:clay_pit } }
				var:bag_wtp_pr1 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_pr1 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto

		}

			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_fillg }

			}
			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes

# coal, rural: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_r2 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 2 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_2 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm2 = 138 var:bag_wtp_prm2 = 139 var:bag_wtp_prm2 = 140 var:bag_wtp_prm2 = 141 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr2 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr2 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:coal }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:charcoal_maker } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:improved_charcoal_maker } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_gbu_walloon_coalworks } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_sil_coal_works } }
				var:bag_wtp_pr2 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_pr2 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
			global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_traded value = 0 }
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_to = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_fillg }
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = var:bag_wtp_fillg }
			}
			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes

		}

			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bfrom value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bgain }

		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_new value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_new add = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bfrom }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_now value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv }

		if = {
			limit = {

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 3 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom

		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched

			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_3 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_pm3 = 142 }

			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_p3 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }

	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load

		if = {
			limit = {

# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_t4 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 4 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_4 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_pm4 = 143 var:bag_wtp_pm4 = 144 var:bag_wtp_pm4 = 145 var:bag_wtp_pm4 = 146 var:bag_wtp_pm4 = 147 var:bag_wtp_pm4 = 148 var:bag_wtp_pm4 = 149 var:bag_wtp_pm4 = 150 var:bag_wtp_pm4 = 151 var:bag_wtp_pm4 = 152 var:bag_wtp_pm4 = 153 var:bag_wtp_pm4 = 154 var:bag_wtp_pm4 = 155 }
				var:bag_wtp_p4 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_p4 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {

# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 4 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_4 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm4 = 148 var:bag_wtp_prm4 = 151 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr4 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr4 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:dyes }

# fiber_crops, rural: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_r5 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 5 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_5 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm5 = 156 var:bag_wtp_prm5 = 157 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr5 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr5 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fiber_crops }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:fiber_crops_farm } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:shoen } }
				var:bag_wtp_pr5 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_pr5 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
			global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_traded value = 0 }

			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_fillg }
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = var:bag_wtp_fillg }
			}
			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bto value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bgain }

		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_now value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv }

			limit = {

# fish, rural: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.

bag_wtp_plan_move_r6 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 6 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_6 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm6 = 280 var:bag_wtp_prm6 = 281 var:bag_wtp_prm6 = 283 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr6 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv

# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 7 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_7 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_pm7 = 284 var:bag_wtp_pm7 = 285 var:bag_wtp_pm7 = 286 }
				var:bag_wtp_p7 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_p7 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fruit }

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }

		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched

			has_variable = bag_wtp_load

			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_7 = yes

# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 8 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_8 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_pm8 = 301 var:bag_wtp_pm8 = 302 var:bag_wtp_pm8 = 303 var:bag_wtp_pm8 = 305 var:bag_wtp_pm8 = 306 var:bag_wtp_pm8 = 307 var:bag_wtp_pm8 = 308 }

# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 8 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_8 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm8 = 301 var:bag_wtp_prm8 = 302 var:bag_wtp_prm8 = 303 var:bag_wtp_prm8 = 304 var:bag_wtp_prm8 = 305 var:bag_wtp_prm8 = 306 var:bag_wtp_prm8 = 307 var:bag_wtp_prm8 = 308 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr8 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr8 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:horses }

				var:bag_wtp_pr8 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_pr8 }

# incense, rural: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_r9 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 9 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_9 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm9 = 309 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr9 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr9 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:incense }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_lxa_forest_camp } }
				var:bag_wtp_pr9 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_pr9 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from

# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 10 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_10 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_pm10 = 311 var:bag_wtp_pm10 = 312 var:bag_wtp_pm10 = 313 var:bag_wtp_pm10 = 314 }
				var:bag_wtp_p10 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_p10 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:iron }

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 10 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom

		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_10 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm10 = 311 var:bag_wtp_prm10 = 312 var:bag_wtp_prm10 = 313 var:bag_wtp_prm10 = 314 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr10 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr10 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:iron }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:bog_iron_smelter } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_ger_bergwerk } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_lot_walloon_forge } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:shoen } }

# ivory, rural: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_r11 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 11 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_11 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm11 = 315 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr11 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr11 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:ivory }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:elephant_hunting_grounds } }
				var:bag_wtp_pr11 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}

# lumber, town: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_t13 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 13 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_13 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_pm13 = 450 var:bag_wtp_pm13 = 451 var:bag_wtp_pm13 = 452 }
				var:bag_wtp_p13 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_p13 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:lumber }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:lumber_mill } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_liv_dampfsagewerk } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:shoen } }
				var:bag_wtp_p13 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}

# lumber, rural: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_r13 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 13 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_13 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm13 = 450 var:bag_wtp_prm13 = 452 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr13 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr13 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:lumber }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:lumber_mill } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:shoen } }
				var:bag_wtp_pr13 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_pr13 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom

		}

		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_traded value = 0 }

			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_fillg }
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = var:bag_wtp_fillg }

			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes

# medicaments, rural: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_r14 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 14 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_14 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm14 = 461 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr14 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr14 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:medicaments }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_kon_palm_oil_press } }
				var:bag_wtp_pr14 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_pr14 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
			global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_traded value = 0 }
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_to = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_fillg }
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = var:bag_wtp_fillg }
			}
			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bto value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bgain }
		}
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_from = {

			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_15 = yes

# sand, town: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_t17 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 17 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_17 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_pm17 = 523 }
				var:bag_wtp_p17 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_p17 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:sand }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:sand_pit } }
				var:bag_wtp_p17 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_p17 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
			global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
		}

		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_traded value = 0 }

			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_fillg }

			}
			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bto value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bgain }
		}
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_from = {
			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes

# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_r17 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 17 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_17 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm17 = 523 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr17 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr17 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:sand }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:sand_pit } }
				var:bag_wtp_pr17 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_pr17 }

		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto

# silk, town: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_t18 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 18 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_18 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_pm18 = 524 var:bag_wtp_pm18 = 525 var:bag_wtp_pm18 = 526 }
				var:bag_wtp_p18 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_p18 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:silk }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:ablaq_palace } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:lucca_silk_production_guild } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_ahm_eka_sarana_workshop } }
				NOT = { OR = { var:bag_wtp_plan_right = 1 } }
				var:bag_wtp_p18 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_p18 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}

# silk, rural: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_r18 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 18 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_18 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm18 = 526 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr18 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr18 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:silk }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_ahm_eka_sarana_workshop } }
				NOT = { OR = { var:bag_wtp_plan_right = 1 } }
				var:bag_wtp_pr18 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_pr18 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto

		}

			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_fillg }

			}
			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes

	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_19 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm19 = 527 var:bag_wtp_prm19 = 528 var:bag_wtp_prm19 = 529 var:bag_wtp_prm19 = 530 var:bag_wtp_prm19 = 532 var:bag_wtp_prm19 = 533 var:bag_wtp_prm19 = 535 var:bag_wtp_prm19 = 536 var:bag_wtp_prm19 = 537 var:bag_wtp_prm19 = 538 var:bag_wtp_prm19 = 539 var:bag_wtp_prm19 = 540 var:bag_wtp_prm19 = 541 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr19 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr19 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {

# stone, town: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_t20 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 20 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_20 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_pm20 = 561 var:bag_wtp_pm20 = 562 var:bag_wtp_pm20 = 563 }
				var:bag_wtp_p20 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_p20 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:stone }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:shoen } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:stone_quarry } }
				var:bag_wtp_p20 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_p20 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
			global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_traded value = 0 }
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_to = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_fillg }
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = var:bag_wtp_fillg }
			}
			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bto value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bgain }
		}
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_from = {
			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bfrom value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bgain }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bfitf value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bfit }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_new value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_new add = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bfrom }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_now value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_now add = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bto }
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg > 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bfitf = 1
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_new > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_now
			}

# stone, rural: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_r20 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 20 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_20 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm20 = 561 var:bag_wtp_prm20 = 562 var:bag_wtp_prm20 = 563 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr20 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr20 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:stone }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:shoen } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:stone_quarry } }
				var:bag_wtp_pr20 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_pr20 }

			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }

	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto

# sugar, rural: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_r21 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 21 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_21 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm21 = 564 var:bag_wtp_prm21 = 565 var:bag_wtp_prm21 = 566 var:bag_wtp_prm21 = 568 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr21 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr21 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:sugar }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_koj_sugar_press } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_mor_sugar_press } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_mtm_plantation_complex } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:sugar_plantation } }
				var:bag_wtp_pr21 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_pr21 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom

		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_traded value = 0 }
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_to = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_fillg }

# tobacco, rural: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_r22 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 22 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_22 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm22 = 573 var:bag_wtp_prm22 = 574 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr22 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr22 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:tobacco }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_pgr_gambier_gardens } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:tobacco_plantation } }
				var:bag_wtp_pr22 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
