# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_r23 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 23 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_23 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm23 = 647 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr23 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr23 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:wild_game }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:eng_royal_forest } }
				var:bag_wtp_pr23 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv

		limit = {

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }

# wool, rural: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_r25 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 25 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_25 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm25 = 665 var:bag_wtp_prm25 = 666 var:bag_wtp_prm25 = 667 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr25 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr25 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:wool }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_cel_clachan } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_rmn_stana } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:sheep_farms } }
				var:bag_wtp_pr25 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_pr25 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto

		}

		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_traded value = 0 }
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_to = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_fillg }
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = var:bag_wtp_fillg }

			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bfrom value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bgain }

		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_new value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_new add = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bfrom }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_now value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv }

		if = {
			limit = {

# fine_cloth, rural: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_r30 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 30 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_30 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm30 = 238 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr30 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr30 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fine_cloth }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_sar_piedmont_filatoio } }
				NOT = { OR = { var:bag_wtp_plan_right = 1 var:bag_wtp_plan_right = 2 var:bag_wtp_plan_right = 9 } }
				var:bag_wtp_pr30 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_pr30 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
			global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_traded value = 0 }
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_to = {

# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 33 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_33 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_pm33 = 293 var:bag_wtp_pm33 = 294 var:bag_wtp_pm33 = 295 var:bag_wtp_pm33 = 296 var:bag_wtp_pm33 = 297 var:bag_wtp_pm33 = 298 var:bag_wtp_pm33 = 299 }
				var:bag_wtp_p33 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv

# glass, rural: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_r33 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 33 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_33 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm33 = 300 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr33 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr33 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:glass }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:rural_glassmaker } }
				NOT = { OR = { var:bag_wtp_plan_right = 7 } }
				var:bag_wtp_pr33 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_pr33 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
			global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_traded value = 0 }
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_to = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_fillg }
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = var:bag_wtp_fillg }
			}
			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bto value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bgain }
		}

			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes

# lacquerware, town: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_t35 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 35 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_35 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_pm35 = 378 var:bag_wtp_pm35 = 379 var:bag_wtp_pm35 = 380 var:bag_wtp_pm35 = 381 var:bag_wtp_pm35 = 382 var:bag_wtp_pm35 = 383 var:bag_wtp_pm35 = 384 var:bag_wtp_pm35 = 385 }
				var:bag_wtp_p35 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_p35 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:lacquerware }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:lacquerware_guild } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:lacquerware_manufactory } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_jap_za_guild_hall } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_lxa_silk_house } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_ryu_lacquerware_workshop } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_svb_lacquerware_atelier } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_ymp_lacquer_workshop } }
				var:bag_wtp_p35 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_p35 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }

	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_36 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_pm36 = 387 var:bag_wtp_pm36 = 388 var:bag_wtp_pm36 = 389 var:bag_wtp_pm36 = 390 var:bag_wtp_pm36 = 391 var:bag_wtp_pm36 = 392 var:bag_wtp_pm36 = 393 var:bag_wtp_pm36 = 394 var:bag_wtp_pm36 = 395 var:bag_wtp_pm36 = 396 var:bag_wtp_pm36 = 397 var:bag_wtp_pm36 = 398 var:bag_wtp_pm36 = 399 var:bag_wtp_pm36 = 400 var:bag_wtp_pm36 = 401 var:bag_wtp_pm36 = 402 var:bag_wtp_pm36 = 403 var:bag_wtp_pm36 = 404 var:bag_wtp_pm36 = 405 var:bag_wtp_pm36 = 406 }

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }

	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom

		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_36 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm36 = 388 var:bag_wtp_prm36 = 392 var:bag_wtp_prm36 = 393 var:bag_wtp_prm36 = 394 var:bag_wtp_prm36 = 395 var:bag_wtp_prm36 = 397 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr36 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}

			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:leather }

# liquor, rural: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_r37 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 37 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_37 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm37 = 431 var:bag_wtp_prm37 = 432 var:bag_wtp_prm37 = 435 var:bag_wtp_prm37 = 436 var:bag_wtp_prm37 = 437 var:bag_wtp_prm37 = 438 var:bag_wtp_prm37 = 444 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr37 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr37 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:liquor }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_fkn_weinberghaus } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_gre_olive_press } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_kaz_kumis_brewery } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_mex_hacienda_grande } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_occ_alambic } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_the_metochion } }
				NOT = { OR = { var:bag_wtp_plan_right = 5 } }
				var:bag_wtp_pr37 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_pr37 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }

	}
	if = {
		limit = {

		}

# naval_supplies, town: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_t39 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 39 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_39 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_pm39 = 465 var:bag_wtp_pm39 = 466 var:bag_wtp_pm39 = 467 var:bag_wtp_pm39 = 468 var:bag_wtp_pm39 = 469 var:bag_wtp_pm39 = 470 var:bag_wtp_pm39 = 471 var:bag_wtp_pm39 = 472 var:bag_wtp_pm39 = 473 var:bag_wtp_pm39 = 474 var:bag_wtp_pm39 = 475 }
				var:bag_wtp_p39 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_p39 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:naval_supplies }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:naval_supplies_guild } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:naval_supplies_manufactory } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:naval_supplies_mill } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:naval_supplies_workshop } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_arc_cilician_workshop } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_fin_sahalaitos } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_fin_tervanpolttaja } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_lat_arsenal } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_lva_amber_workshop } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_nse_longship_yards } }
				NOT = { OR = { var:bag_wtp_plan_right = 8 var:bag_wtp_plan_right = 13 } }
				var:bag_wtp_p39 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_p39 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
			global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_traded value = 0 }
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_to = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_fillg }
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = var:bag_wtp_fillg }
			}
			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bto value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bgain }
		}
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_from = {
			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bfrom value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bgain }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bfitf value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bfit }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_new value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_new add = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bfrom }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_now value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_now add = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bto }
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg > 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bfitf = 1
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_new > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_now
			}
			scope:bag_wtp_mv_to = {
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 1 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_1 = yes

			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_39 = yes

# paper, rural: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_r40 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 40 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_40 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm40 = 478 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr40 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr40 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:paper }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_the_metochion } }
				NOT = { OR = { var:bag_wtp_plan_right = 4 } }
				var:bag_wtp_pr40 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_pr40 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
			global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_traded value = 0 }
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_to = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_fillg }
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = var:bag_wtp_fillg }
			}
			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bto value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bgain }
		}
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_from = {
			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bfrom value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bgain }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bfitf value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bfit }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_new value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_new add = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bfrom }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_now value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_now add = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bto }
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg > 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bfitf = 1
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_new > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_now
			}
			scope:bag_wtp_mv_to = {
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 1 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_1 = yes
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_1 = yes
				}
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 2 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_2 = yes
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_2 = yes
				}
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 3 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_3 = yes
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_3 = yes
				}

# slaves_goods, town: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_t43 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 43 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_43 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_pm43 = 542 var:bag_wtp_pm43 = 543 }
				var:bag_wtp_p43 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_p43 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:slaves_goods }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:slave_center } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:slave_market } }
				var:bag_wtp_p43 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_p43 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
			global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_traded value = 0 }
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_to = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_fillg }
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = var:bag_wtp_fillg }
			}
			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bto value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bgain }
		}
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_from = {
			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bfrom value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bgain }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bfitf value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bfit }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_new value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_new add = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bfrom }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_now value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_now add = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bto }
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg > 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bfitf = 1
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_new > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_now
			}
			scope:bag_wtp_mv_to = {
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 1 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_1 = yes
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_1 = yes
				}
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 2 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_2 = yes
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_2 = yes
				}
				if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bg = 3 }
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_3 = yes
					bag_wtp_edit_remove_rural_3 = yes

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 43 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_43 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm43 = 542 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr43 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr43 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:slaves_goods }

# steel, rural: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_r44 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 44 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_44 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm44 = 553 var:bag_wtp_prm44 = 554 var:bag_wtp_prm44 = 557 var:bag_wtp_prm44 = 558 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr44 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr44 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:steel }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_occ_forga_del_roergue } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_pon_argyria_refining_works } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_sil_coal_works } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_slo_banska_mines } }
				var:bag_wtp_pr44 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_pr44 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_from
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
			global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_traded value = 0 }
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_to = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_fillg }
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bg value = var:bag_wtp_fillg }
			}
			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bto value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bgain }
		}
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_from = {
			bag_wtp_mv_read_b = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bfrom value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bgain }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bfitf value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bfit }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_new value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_new add = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bfrom }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_now value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_now add = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bto }
		if = {
			limit = {

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }

	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_45 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_pm45 = 569 var:bag_wtp_pm45 = 570 var:bag_wtp_pm45 = 571 var:bag_wtp_pm45 = 572 }
				var:bag_wtp_p45 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_p45 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }

# tools, rural: один переезд за круг -- из худшей своей провинции в
# лучшую чужую, обменом с тем, кто там стоит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_r46 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = 10000 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_ag value = 46 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_hasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_46 = yes
				OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm46 = 581 var:bag_wtp_prm46 = 584 var:bag_wtp_prm46 = 598 var:bag_wtp_prm46 = 602 var:bag_wtp_prm46 = 603 var:bag_wtp_prm46 = 605 }
				var:bag_wtp_pr46 > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_bv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_bv value = var:bag_wtp_pr46 }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_to
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_hasto value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:tools }
				OR = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_bno_diamond_workshop } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_eur_continental_railway } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_msi_forge } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_sca_koppargruva } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_slo_banska_mines } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:tatara } }

				var:bag_wtp_pr46 < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_wv

			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_wv value = var:bag_wtp_pr46 }

# Общее для обмена грамотами: всё про **чужую** грамоту, с которой меняемся. Её
# номер лежит в `_mv_rj`, а по номеру-переменной ни выгоду (`_rq<k>`), ни
# «влезет ли сюда» (`_edit_right_fits_<k>`) не прочитать -- отсюда один
# переключатель на всех, ровно как `_mv_read_b` у товаров.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_mv_read_right = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rjv value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rjfit value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rj = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_psrq value = bag_wtp_rq1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rjv value = var:bag_wtp_psrq }
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_edit_right_fits_1 = yes }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rjfit value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rj = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_psrq value = bag_wtp_rq2 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rjv value = var:bag_wtp_psrq }
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_edit_right_fits_2 = yes }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rjfit value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rj = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_psrq value = bag_wtp_rq3 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rjv value = var:bag_wtp_psrq }
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_edit_right_fits_3 = yes }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rjfit value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rj = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_psrq value = bag_wtp_rq4 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rjv value = var:bag_wtp_psrq }
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_edit_right_fits_4 = yes }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rjfit value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rj = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_psrq value = bag_wtp_rq5 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rjv value = var:bag_wtp_psrq }
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_edit_right_fits_5 = yes }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rjfit value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {

# constantinopolitan_silk_monopoly_rights: один переезд за круг -- из худшего своего города в лучший чужой,
# обменом грамотами с тем, кто там сидит.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_move_right_1 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rbv value = -1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rwv value = 10000 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_rhasto
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_rhasfrom
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = {
			has_variable = bag_wtp_load
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
			has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_right
		}
		# Выгода грамоты здесь -- в переменную локации: бегущий минимум и
		# максимум лежат в глобалках, а `var:x > global_var:y` -- единственная
		# форма сравнения, доказанная в этом моде везде.
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_psrq value = bag_wtp_rq1 }
		# Куда: чужой город, где ей платят больше всего и где она может стоять.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { var:bag_wtp_plan_right = 1 }
				bag_wtp_edit_right_fits_1 = yes
				var:bag_wtp_psrq > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rbv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rbv value = var:bag_wtp_psrq }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_rto
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rhasto value = 1 }
		}
		# Откуда: свой город, где ей платят меньше всего.
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_plan_right = 1
				var:bag_wtp_psrq < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rwv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rwv value = var:bag_wtp_psrq }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_rfrom
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rhasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_rhasto
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_rhasfrom
			global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rbv > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rwv
		}
		# Чья грамота сидит в цели, что она там получает и что получит у нас.
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_rto = {
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rj value = var:bag_wtp_plan_right }
			bag_wtp_mv_read_right = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rjb value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rjv }
		}
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_rfrom = {
			bag_wtp_mv_read_right = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rja value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rjv }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rjfa value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rjfit }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rnew value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rbv }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rnew add = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rja }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rnow value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rwv }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rnow add = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rjb }
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rjfa = 1
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rnew > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rnow
			}
			# **Обе стороны через `_edit_right_swap`**, а не своим кодом: он
			# снимает пачку целиком, освобождает комнату под приезжающую и
			# выравнивает загрузку города -- то же, что делают «+1» и «−1».
			scope:bag_wtp_mv_rto = {
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_rfrom value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rj }
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_rto value = 1 }
				bag_wtp_edit_right_swap = yes
			}
			scope:bag_wtp_mv_rfrom = {
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_rfrom value = 1 }
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_rto value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rj }
				bag_wtp_edit_right_swap = yes
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_did value = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_rswaps add = 1 }
		}
	}
}

				var:bag_wtp_psrq < global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rwv
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rwv value = var:bag_wtp_psrq }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_mv_rfrom
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rhasfrom value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_rhasto
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_mv_rhasfrom
			global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rbv > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rwv
		}
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_rto = {
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rj value = var:bag_wtp_plan_right }
			bag_wtp_mv_read_right = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rjb value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rjv }
		}
		scope:bag_wtp_mv_rfrom = {
			bag_wtp_mv_read_right = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rja value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rjv }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rjfa value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rjfit }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rnew value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rbv }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rnew add = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rja }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rnow value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rwv }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_mv_rnow add = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rjb }
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rjfa = 1
				global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rnew > global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rnow
			}
			scope:bag_wtp_mv_rto = {
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_rfrom value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rj }
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_rto value = 11 }
				bag_wtp_edit_right_swap = yes
			}
			scope:bag_wtp_mv_rfrom = {
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_rfrom value = 11 }
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_rto value = global_var:bag_wtp_mv_rj }
				bag_wtp_edit_right_swap = yes
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_did value = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ps_rswaps add = 1 }
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm33 > 0 }
		if = { limit = { bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_33 = yes } change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esrn add = 1 } }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_17 = yes } change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esrn add = 1 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_38 = yes } change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esrn add = 1 } }
}

# royal_masonry_rights: glass, masonry -- off this town, bundle and all.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_right_out_7 = {
	# The substitute goes in only where the ground cannot make
	# the bundle good at all. **`_plan_can_town_<n>` is not that
	# question**: it also wants a free room, so on a full town it
	# would plant the substitute every time and the removal would
	# take out the wrong building.
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm33 > 0 }
		bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_33 = yes
	}
	else = { bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_17 = yes }
	bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_38 = yes
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_right
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rn7 subtract = 1 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven7 subtract = 1 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rightn subtract = 1 }
}

# royal_masonry_rights: onto this town, bundle and all.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_right_in_7 = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm33 > 0 }
		bag_wtp_edit_place_town_33 = yes
	}

}

# **One room made for the arriving bundle, if it still needs one.** Called three
# times: three is the largest bundle in the game, so a swap can be short by no
# more than that.
#
# `_esrn` is how many rooms the bundle wants and `_load` how many are taken, so
# their sum against the cap is the whole question. It is recomputed each time
# because `_edit_take_worst` moves `_load`.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_right_make_room = {
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esrneed value = var:bag_wtp_load }
	change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esrneed add = var:bag_wtp_esrn }
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_esrneed > global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban }
		bag_wtp_edit_take_worst = yes
	}
}

# The load, squared up after a swap. Three each way: three is the largest bundle
# in the game, so the two sides of a swap can differ by no more than that.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_right_fix_load = {
	if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_load > global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban }
		bag_wtp_edit_take_worst = yes }
	if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_load > global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban }
		bag_wtp_edit_take_worst = yes }
	if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_load > global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban }
		bag_wtp_edit_take_worst = yes }
	if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban }
		bag_wtp_edit_fill_room = yes }
	if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban }
		bag_wtp_edit_fill_room = yes }
	if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban }
		bag_wtp_edit_fill_room = yes }
}

# One town's charter exchanged for another. **Out before in**, because the rooms
# the old bundle frees are the ones the new one wants, and the load is squared up
# only once both have moved.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_right_swap = {
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 1 } bag_wtp_edit_right_out_1 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 2 } bag_wtp_edit_right_out_2 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 3 } bag_wtp_edit_right_out_3 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 4 } bag_wtp_edit_right_out_4 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 5 } bag_wtp_edit_right_out_5 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 6 } bag_wtp_edit_right_out_6 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 7 } bag_wtp_edit_right_out_7 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 8 } bag_wtp_edit_right_out_8 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 9 } bag_wtp_edit_right_out_9 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 10 } bag_wtp_edit_right_out_10 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 11 } bag_wtp_edit_right_out_11 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 12 } bag_wtp_edit_right_out_12 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 13 } bag_wtp_edit_right_out_13 = yes }
	# **Room first, then the bundle.** `_edit_place_town_<n>` refuses on a
	# full town -- the invariant that stopped 27 buildings going over the cap
	# on 2026-09-04 -- so a bundle bigger than the one it replaces used to
	# lose its extra building without a word. He caught it: «ювелирный домик
	# уходит, а стекольному праву надо два, и для кладки места не нашлось».
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 1 } bag_wtp_edit_right_need_1 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 2 } bag_wtp_edit_right_need_2 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 3 } bag_wtp_edit_right_need_3 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 4 } bag_wtp_edit_right_need_4 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 5 } bag_wtp_edit_right_need_5 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 6 } bag_wtp_edit_right_need_6 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 7 } bag_wtp_edit_right_need_7 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 8 } bag_wtp_edit_right_need_8 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 9 } bag_wtp_edit_right_need_9 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 10 } bag_wtp_edit_right_need_10 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 11 } bag_wtp_edit_right_need_11 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 12 } bag_wtp_edit_right_need_12 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 13 } bag_wtp_edit_right_need_13 = yes }
	bag_wtp_edit_right_make_room = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_right_make_room = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_right_make_room = yes
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 1 } bag_wtp_edit_right_in_1 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 2 } bag_wtp_edit_right_in_2 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 3 } bag_wtp_edit_right_in_3 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 4 } bag_wtp_edit_right_in_4 = yes }

	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 13 } bag_wtp_edit_right_in_13 = yes }
	# **And the same count again, which is now what did not get in.** Zero is
	# the answer the press line wants; anything else means the town had
	# nothing left it was allowed to give up, and that is worth saying out
	# loud rather than leaving a charter standing with half a bundle.
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esrn value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 1 } bag_wtp_edit_right_need_1 = yes }
	if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 2 } bag_wtp_edit_right_need_2 = yes }

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_rshort value = var:bag_wtp_esrn }
	bag_wtp_edit_right_fix_load = yes
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_seq value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_presses }

# Everything a charter press reads that does not vary by location.
#
# `_rsh<k>` is how far charter k is below its share and `_rover<k>` says it is at
# or above it -- **the same share the plan itself granted by**, `_rquota`, which
# is towns divided by the charters this country may grant. `_rok<k>` is that
# permission, asked once at country scope because `_plan_right_gate_<k>` is a
# country trigger and a walk cannot ask one from a location.
#
# `_esover` is the answer carried onto each town: whether the charter it holds
# now is one that has more than its share. Thirteen branches once, rather than
# thirteen inside every charter's own block.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_right_prepare = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_rquota } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rquota value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_rn1 } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rn1 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven1 value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_rn2 } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rn2 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven2 value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_rn3 } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rn3 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven3 value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_rn4 } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rn4 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven4 value = 0 }

		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven5 value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_rn6 } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rn6 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven6 value = 0 }
	}
	if = {

		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rn7 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven7 value = 0 }

		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven13 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Not floored at zero, and that is the point.** With a share of 5, a
	# charter holding 6 towns and one holding 5 both have «no shortfall»,
	# and a floor would make them equal -- so «−1» could hand a town to the
	# charter that already has the most. Negative reads «over its share by
	# that much», and the walk prefers the larger number.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rsh1 value = global_var:bag_wtp_rquota }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rsh1 subtract = global_var:bag_wtp_rn1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rover1 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_rquota > global_var:bag_wtp_rn1 } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rover1 value = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rok1 value = 0 }

	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_rquota > global_var:bag_wtp_rn2 } }

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rover3 value = 0 }
	if = {

# How many towns the scan found. Its own effect because «+1» runs the scan twice
# -- strict, then open -- and the count has to mean the same thing both times.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_right_count = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_cands value = 0 }
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_esc = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_cands add = 1 }
	}
}

# **«+1» on a charter: one more town for it, taken from a charter that has more
# than its share.** Two passes, strict then open, exactly as «+1» on a good.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_right_add = {
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_presses add = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_clear_trace = yes
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_done value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_fail value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_norefill value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_op value = 3 }
	bag_wtp_edit_right_prepare = yes
	# **`_edit_strict` stays 0 through a charter press.** It steers
	# `_edit_worst`, which is what squares the load up after the swap;
	# left at 1 it would refuse to shed a building unless some good were
	# over its share, and the town would stay above its cap. The charter
	# scan has its own two passes and reads `_esover` instead.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_cands value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_right > 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_right = 1 global_var:bag_wtp_rok1 = 1 }
			every_in_global_list = {
				variable = bag_wtp_candidates
				limit = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_right
					NOT = { var:bag_wtp_plan_right = 1 }
					bag_wtp_edit_right_fits_1 = yes
					var:bag_wtp_esover = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = bag_wtp_rq1 }
			}
			bag_wtp_edit_right_count = yes
			if = {
				limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_cands = 0 }
				every_in_global_list = {
					variable = bag_wtp_candidates
					limit = {
						bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
						has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_right
						NOT = { var:bag_wtp_plan_right = 1 }
						bag_wtp_edit_right_fits_1 = yes
					}
					set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = bag_wtp_rq1 }
				}
				bag_wtp_edit_right_count = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_right = 2 global_var:bag_wtp_rok2 = 1 }
			every_in_global_list = {
				variable = bag_wtp_candidates
				limit = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_right
					NOT = { var:bag_wtp_plan_right = 2 }
					bag_wtp_edit_right_fits_2 = yes
					var:bag_wtp_esover = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = bag_wtp_rq2 }
			}
			bag_wtp_edit_right_count = yes
			if = {
				limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_cands = 0 }
				every_in_global_list = {
					variable = bag_wtp_candidates
					limit = {
						bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
						has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_right
						NOT = { var:bag_wtp_plan_right = 2 }
						bag_wtp_edit_right_fits_2 = yes
					}
					set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = bag_wtp_rq2 }
				}
				bag_wtp_edit_right_count = yes
			}

# **Which charter this town should get instead**, of those below their share and
# able to stand here. Shortfall first, what the ground pays for it as the
# tie-break -- the same two keys, in the same order, as the fill uses for goods.
#
# `_esrj` is 0 when nothing qualifies, and **that is a refusal and not a
# default**: a town with no charter at all is a state the plan never produces.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_right_best_here = {
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esrj value = 0 }
	# Below any shortfall a real ground can produce: a charter over its share
	# by every town of the realm would still beat this.
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esrd value = -9999 }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esrv value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 1 }
			bag_wtp_edit_right_fits_1 = yes
			global_var:bag_wtp_rok1 = 1
			OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_esrd < global_var:bag_wtp_rsh1
				AND = {
					var:bag_wtp_esrd = global_var:bag_wtp_rsh1
					var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_esrv
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esrd value = global_var:bag_wtp_rsh1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esrv value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esrj value = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq2 }

# **«−1» on a charter: off the town where it earns least, and that town goes to
# whichever charter is furthest below its share.** The town keeps a charter --
# the plan grants one to every town it can, and «снять и посадить в другой» is
# what he asked for, not «снять».

# **«−1» на грамоте, провинцией целиком.** Грамота уходит из той провинции, где
# она зарабатывает меньше всего, и **вся провинция** получает одну замену --
# ту, которую `_edit_right_best_here` назовёт её первому городу.
#
# **Замена выбирается один раз, а не в каждом городе.** Спросить каждый город
# значило бы снова собрать в провинции мешанину -- то самое, на что он и
# жалуется; поэтому ответ первого города лежит в `_edit_rprovto` и достаётся
# всем. Города, где эта грамота встанет не целиком, всё равно её получают: так
# же поступает и раздача плана.

							has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_right
							var:bag_wtp_plan_right = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_right
						}
						bag_wtp_edit_right_swap = yes
					}
				}
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_done value = 1 }
			}
			else = { set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_fail value = 1 } }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_load2 value = var:bag_wtp_load }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_done = 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_idle add = 1 }
	}
	bag_wtp_edit_reshuffle = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_journal = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_rank = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_show = yes
}

			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_rfrom value = var:bag_wtp_plan_right }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_rto value = 1 }

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_right_prepare = yes
	global_var:bag_wtp_swap_loc = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_right
				NOT = { var:bag_wtp_plan_right = 11 }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_hit value = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_town value = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_load value = var:bag_wtp_load }
			save_scope_as = bag_wtp_ev_where
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_loc value = scope:bag_wtp_ev_where }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_rfrom value = var:bag_wtp_plan_right }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_rto value = 11 }
			bag_wtp_edit_right_swap = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_load2 value = var:bag_wtp_load }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_done value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_done = 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_idle add = 1 }
	}
	bag_wtp_edit_reshuffle = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_journal = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_rank = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_show = yes
	bag_wtp_swap_rebuild = yes
}

# **The baseline every «изменено» is measured against.**
#
# Written by `bag_wtp_plan_run` as well, so a fresh plan is its own baseline and
# the changes list right after one is empty -- which is the true answer, since a
# new plan has not been edited. Saving a slot re-bases it too, and so does
# loading one: «показать изменения» always answers «что я поменял с тех пор, как
# сохранил или загрузил», and never «чем этот план отличается от какого-то
# другого».
#
# Only the goods are kept. The building each good used is `_pm<n>`, which the
# scoring pass writes and no edit touches, so restoring puts it back from the
# good alone and the baseline needs no second list.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_save = {
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_save_locs
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_save_goods
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_save_vill
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:clay } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:coal } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:coal } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:cotton } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:cotton } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:dyes } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:dyes } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fiber_crops } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:fiber_crops } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fish } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:fish } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fruit } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:fruit } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:horses } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:horses } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:incense } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:incense } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:iron } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:iron } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:ivory } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:ivory } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:livestock } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:livestock } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:lumber } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:lumber } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:medicaments } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:medicaments } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:salt } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:salt } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:saltpeter } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:saltpeter } }

		}
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_save_load value = var:bag_wtp_load }
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_save_right
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_right }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_save_right value = var:bag_wtp_plan_right }
		}
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_locs target = this }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_save_n value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_placed }
}

# «+1» for clay.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_plus_1 = {
	# **Asking for more of a good contradicts «не нужен», so the flag goes.**
	# The alternative is a «+1» that silently refuses, and a button that does
	# nothing is the thing this mod has already paid for twice. He reported the
	# opposite defect on 2026-09-05 -- the flag set and the good still growing --
	# and this is the honest reading of the two presses together: the last one
	# wins, and it is visible because the checkbox clears.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip1 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip1
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 1 }
	# The same good as a scope, because the press line has to name it and a
	# number has no name. Here it is free: the cell is written out per good, so
	# the good is known without a dispatch.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:clay }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_add = yes
	# **A press is a statement, and it sticks.** `_lock<n>` becomes the count the
	# good ended on, so the share below is computed for the goods the player has
	# not spoken about and this one keeps what it was given. Written after the
	# operation and unconditionally: a press that was refused still says «I want
	# this good here», and pinning it where it stands is the honest reading.
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_1 = yes
}

# clay pinned where the press left it, or released if it stands nowhere.
#
# **Set or absent, never zero.** The pin is drawn in the picker by
# `GetGlobalVariable(...).IsSet`, the same form the game uses for its own flags,
# and a variable holding 0 is «set» to that reader. It still carries the count it
# was pinned at, for the day a new ground has to ask whether the share has
# outgrown it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_pin_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_pn1 > 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lock1 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn1 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_lock1
	}
}

# «не нужен» for clay: the standing instruction, toggled.
#
# **It removes nothing.** «Держит товар на одном домике, не на нуле», and it
# only forbids the fill from topping the good up again -- the player presses
# «−1» down to one himself, once, and the flag is what stops it coming back on
# this ground and on every ground after. Its whole purpose is «чтобы не кликать
# их в минус при каждом добавлении земли».
#
# Absent means off, which is why this sets and removes rather than writing 0.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_skip_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip1 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip1
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_skip1 value = 1 }
	}
	# The share below is computed for the goods still free, and this press just
	# changed which those are.
	bag_wtp_edit_set_quota = yes
}

# «−1» for clay.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_minus_1 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:clay }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_drop = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_1 = yes
}

		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip7
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 7 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:fruit }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_add = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_7 = yes
}

# fruit pinned where the press left it, or released if it stands nowhere.
#
# **Set or absent, never zero.** The pin is drawn in the picker by
# `GetGlobalVariable(...).IsSet`, the same form the game uses for its own flags,
# and a variable holding 0 is «set» to that reader. It still carries the count it
# was pinned at, for the day a new ground has to ask whether the share has
# outgrown it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_pin_7 = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_pn7 > 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lock7 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn7 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_lock7
	}
}

# «не нужен» for fruit: the standing instruction, toggled.
#
# **It removes nothing.** «Держит товар на одном домике, не на нуле», and it
# only forbids the fill from topping the good up again -- the player presses
# «−1» down to one himself, once, and the flag is what stops it coming back on
# this ground and on every ground after. Its whole purpose is «чтобы не кликать
# их в минус при каждом добавлении земли».
#
# Absent means off, which is why this sets and removes rather than writing 0.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_skip_7 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip7 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip7
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_skip7 value = 1 }
	}
	bag_wtp_edit_set_quota = yes
}

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_drop = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_7 = yes

#
# Absent means off, which is why this sets and removes rather than writing 0.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_skip_16 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip16 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip16
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_skip16 value = 1 }
	}
	bag_wtp_edit_set_quota = yes
}

	bag_wtp_edit_pin_17 = yes
}

# sand pinned where the press left it, or released if it stands nowhere.
#
# **Set or absent, never zero.** The pin is drawn in the picker by
# `GetGlobalVariable(...).IsSet`, the same form the game uses for its own flags,
# and a variable holding 0 is «set» to that reader. It still carries the count it
# was pinned at, for the day a new ground has to ask whether the share has
# outgrown it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_pin_17 = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_pn17 > 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lock17 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn17 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_lock17
	}
}

# «не нужен» for sand: the standing instruction, toggled.
#
# **It removes nothing.** «Держит товар на одном домике, не на нуле», and it
# only forbids the fill from topping the good up again -- the player presses
# «−1» down to one himself, once, and the flag is what stops it coming back on
# this ground and on every ground after. Its whole purpose is «чтобы не кликать
# их в минус при каждом добавлении земли».

#
# **Set or absent, never zero.** The pin is drawn in the picker by
# `GetGlobalVariable(...).IsSet`, the same form the game uses for its own flags,
# and a variable holding 0 is «set» to that reader. It still carries the count it
# was pinned at, for the day a new ground has to ask whether the share has
# outgrown it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_pin_26 = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_pn26 > 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lock26 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn26 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_lock26
	}
}

# «не нужен» for beer: the standing instruction, toggled.
#
# **It removes nothing.** «Держит товар на одном домике, не на нуле», and it
# only forbids the fill from topping the good up again -- the player presses
# «−1» down to one himself, once, and the flag is what stops it coming back on
# this ground and on every ground after. Its whole purpose is «чтобы не кликать
# их в минус при каждом добавлении земли».
#
# Absent means off, which is why this sets and removes rather than writing 0.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_skip_26 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip26 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip26
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_skip26 value = 1 }
	}
	bag_wtp_edit_set_quota = yes
}

# «−1» for beer.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_minus_26 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 26 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:beer }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_drop = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_26 = yes
}

# leather pinned where the press left it, or released if it stands nowhere.
#
# **Set or absent, never zero.** The pin is drawn in the picker by
# `GetGlobalVariable(...).IsSet`, the same form the game uses for its own flags,
# and a variable holding 0 is «set» to that reader. It still carries the count it
# was pinned at, for the day a new ground has to ask whether the share has
# outgrown it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_pin_36 = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_pn36 > 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lock36 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn36 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_lock36
	}
}

# «не нужен» for leather: the standing instruction, toggled.
#
# **It removes nothing.** «Держит товар на одном домике, не на нуле», and it
# only forbids the fill from topping the good up again -- the player presses
# «−1» down to one himself, once, and the flag is what stops it coming back on
# this ground and on every ground after. Its whole purpose is «чтобы не кликать
# их в минус при каждом добавлении земли».
#
# Absent means off, which is why this sets and removes rather than writing 0.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_skip_36 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip36 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip36
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_skip36 value = 1 }
	}
	bag_wtp_edit_set_quota = yes
}

		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_pn45 > 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lock45 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn45 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_lock45
	}
}

# «не нужен» for tar: the standing instruction, toggled.
#
# **It removes nothing.** «Держит товар на одном домике, не на нуле», and it
# only forbids the fill from topping the good up again -- the player presses
# «−1» down to one himself, once, and the flag is what stops it coming back on
# this ground and on every ground after. Its whole purpose is «чтобы не кликать
# их в минус при каждом добавлении земли».
#
# Absent means off, which is why this sets and removes rather than writing 0.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_skip_45 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip45 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip45
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_skip45 value = 1 }
	}
	bag_wtp_edit_set_quota = yes
}

# «−1» for tar.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_minus_45 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 45 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:tar }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_drop = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_45 = yes
}

# tools pinned where the press left it, or released if it stands nowhere.
#
# **Set or absent, never zero.** The pin is drawn in the picker by
# `GetGlobalVariable(...).IsSet`, the same form the game uses for its own flags,
# and a variable holding 0 is «set» to that reader. It still carries the count it
# was pinned at, for the day a new ground has to ask whether the share has
# outgrown it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_pin_46 = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_pn46 > 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lock46 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn46 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_lock46
	}

# Slot 3 back onto the map, in place of whatever the plan holds now.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_load_3 = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_sl3_n > 0 }
		bag_wtp_edit_clear_plan = yes
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_sl3_locs
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_touched target = this }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_sl3_right }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_right value = var:bag_wtp_sl3_right }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rightn add = 1 }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl3_right = 1 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven1 add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl3_right = 2 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven2 add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl3_right = 3 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven3 add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl3_right = 4 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven4 add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl3_right = 5 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven5 add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl3_right = 6 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven6 add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl3_right = 7 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven7 add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl3_right = 8 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven8 add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl3_right = 9 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven9 add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl3_right = 10 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven10 add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl3_right = 11 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven11 add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl3_right = 12 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven12 add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl3_right = 13 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven13 add = 1 } }
			}
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_sl3_goods target = goods:clay } }
				bag_wtp_plan_try_town_1 = yes
				bag_wtp_plan_try_rural_1 = yes
			}
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_sl3_goods target = goods:coal } }
				bag_wtp_plan_try_town_2 = yes
				bag_wtp_plan_try_rural_2 = yes

# «Показать изменения»: every location where the plan now differs from the saved
# one, and nothing else.
#
# **It fills a window and writes the same report to the log.** The window is what
# he asked for -- «кнопка показать список изменений, которое откроет ещё одно
# окно» -- and the log line stays because `mods.bat -> «Забрать диагностику из игры»` and `tools/diag.py`
# already fold a location's `LD` lines into «изменено: убрано X; добавлено Y»,
# which is how a change gets into a session without a screenshot.
#
# **Two lists on the location and a count beside them.** `_chg_out` is what left,
# `_chg_in` is what arrived, and `_chg_n` is how many of both -- the count is
# there because a `limit` cannot ask whether a variable list is empty, and
# `bag_wtp_chg_locs` must hold only the locations that really moved. Only those
# are printed, so after one edit the whole report is two lines, which is the
# point of the thing.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_changes = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_moved value = 0 }
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_chg_locs
	debug_log_date = yes
	error_log = "WTP the changes list is in debug.log, tag WTP. mods.bat -> «Забрать диагностику из игры» takes it out."
	debug_log = "WTP ==== BEGIN v5 ==== the plan against the saved one"
	# **Первый проход считает разницу, второй раскладывает её по порядку.**
	# `_chg_rank` -- ключ сортировки: `10000 − номер нажатия`, потому что
	# `order_by` читает от большего к меньшему, а нужен порядок нажатий.
	# Локация, изменённая не нажатием (новый план против старого слота),
	# ранга не получает и уходит в конец списка -- у неё номера нет.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_chg_out
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_chg_in
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_chg_bout
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_chg_bin
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_n value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_rank value = 0 }
		# **A moved charter is a change even when no building moved.** Two
		# charters can share a whole bundle -- royal_naval_rights and
		# scandinavian_tar_privileges are both naval_supplies and tar -- and
		# without this the town would be missing from the list it belongs in.
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_right NOT = { has_variable = bag_wtp_save_right } }
					AND = { has_variable = bag_wtp_save_right NOT = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_right } }
					AND = {
						has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_right
						has_variable = bag_wtp_save_right
						NOT = { var:bag_wtp_plan_right = var:bag_wtp_save_right }
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_n add = 1 }
		}
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:clay } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay } } NOT = { OR = { AND = { var:bag_wtp_vw1 = 1 AND = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_vill target = building_type:fishing_village } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:fishing_village } } } } AND = { var:bag_wtp_vw2 = 1 AND = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_vill target = building_type:forest_village } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:forest_village } } } } AND = { var:bag_wtp_vw3 = 1 AND = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_vill target = building_type:market_village } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:market_village } } } } } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_chg_out target = goods:clay }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_n add = 1 }
		}
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:clay } } NOT = { OR = { AND = { var:bag_wtp_vw1 = 1 AND = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:fishing_village } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_vill target = building_type:fishing_village } } } } AND = { var:bag_wtp_vw2 = 1 AND = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:forest_village } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_vill target = building_type:forest_village } } } } AND = { var:bag_wtp_vw3 = 1 AND = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:market_village } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_vill target = building_type:market_village } } } } } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_chg_in target = goods:clay }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_n add = 1 }
		}
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:coal } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:coal } } NOT = { OR = { AND = { var:bag_wtp_vw1 = 2 AND = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_vill target = building_type:fishing_village } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:fishing_village } } } } AND = { var:bag_wtp_vw2 = 2 AND = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_vill target = building_type:forest_village } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:forest_village } } } } AND = { var:bag_wtp_vw3 = 2 AND = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_vill target = building_type:market_village } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:market_village } } } } } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_chg_out target = goods:coal }

		}

			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_chg_out target = goods:cotton }

		}
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:cotton } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:cotton } } NOT = { OR = { AND = { var:bag_wtp_vw1 = 3 AND = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:fishing_village } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_vill target = building_type:fishing_village } } } } AND = { var:bag_wtp_vw2 = 3 AND = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:forest_village } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_vill target = building_type:forest_village } } } } AND = { var:bag_wtp_vw3 = 3 AND = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:market_village } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_vill target = building_type:market_village } } } } } } }
